work_process_text: My workday mainly consists of writing code. This process is a continuous cycle of problem-solving, finding optimal solutions, and of course debugging, which sometimes takes longer than initially expected.
tech_stack_text: I use JavaScript and React as my main tools, for which I have deep professional sympathy for their flexibility and capabilities. At the same time, I devote time to studying Computer Science and algorithms to use the most optimal and fastest solutions.
web_focus_text: The main focus of my activity, however, is shifted towards web development. This direction requires constant learning of new things and offers a constant challenge to myself and my skills, which makes it so attractive to me, despite my long-standing attachment to the Apple ecosystem.
community_text: In this regard, I feel the need to join a professional community of like-minded people. Sharing experience and networking with colleagues who share similar interests is extremely valuable for both personal and career growth. I hope this will happen someday and together we will build a new "World" by creating our own ecosystem.
books_promo_text: By the way, I also read a lot of books.
